_comment: Mission-console-only hooks, attached at launch via `claude --settings`. Loaded ADDITIVELY (it merges with normal user/project settings, it does not replace them). Wired by console-session.sh (ops), console-session-wt.sh -> claude-miss (dev), and scripts/claude-miss-integrator (integrator, when given its mission name), so it never affects the operator's own Claude sessions. Driven by $MISSION_* abs paths the launch scripts export. Bark pushes: Notification + Stop also run $MISSION_NOTIFY (scripts/notify) — guarded so a missing export is a no-op, and the script itself no-ops unless ~/.miss-claude/bark.env is configured AND the mission's mission.json says notifications:true (the dashboard's 🔔 toggle). SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit -> $MISSION_CONSOLE_SESSION records the transcript THIS console is writing to <mission dir>/.console-session, so the dashboard's context badge reads the right session instead of inferring one from the cwd (a console outlives the session id it started from: a /clear opens a new session file mid-process and abandons the old one). SessionStart -> $DOSKA_PROJECT_CONTEXT (scripts/doska-project-context.py) prints the Doska Projects identity block (worktree = $MISS_WORKTREE, else the mission folder); UserPromptSubmit runs it with `prompt`, which re-sends the label once when the mission's display name changes. REMOVED 2026-09-07 at the operator's request: the mission-doc nudges — a UserPromptSubmit staleness reminder, a PostToolUse(Bash) milestone marker, and a Stop hook that blocked the stop until LOG/DASHBOARD were written. Mission docs are no longer nudged, recorded or enforced by any hook; a session updates them only if it decides to. PermissionRequest + Notification -> $MISSION_CONSOLE_SESSION touches <mission dir>/.console-permission when a permission dialog opens, so the dashboard shows the console as waiting (red) instead of working while it sits on the prompt. SessionStart -> $MISS_AGENT_CONTEXT (scripts/miss-agent-context.py) prints agents/<role>.md when mission.json names an `agent_role` (the room's roles), guarded like the director hook; UserPromptSubmit runs it with `prompt`, which adds a room member's unread posts (status posts, result copies: never typed) to that prompt, once.
